## August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 349)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio, BBC Light Programme, and syndication, John Daly & Ken Roberts reporting live from Rouen marketplace during the trial of Joan of Arc on *You Are There* (1948), Joseph Cotten dramatizing wartime air transport over the Himalayas on *Ceiling Unlimited* for Lockheed (1943), Jack Mather & Mel Blanc as *The Cisco Kid* (1957), Marvin Miller's *Armchair Adventures*, *Ma Perkins* for Oxydol, and Jimmy Edwards in *Whack-O!* (1943–1961):
